passive.name: Divine Ascent
passive.description: Kayle's attacks are empowered by the heavens as she levels up and spends skill points. Her wings are lit aflame as she progressively gains Attack Speed, Move Speed, Attack Range, and waves of fire on her attacks.

primaryAbilities.name: Radiant Blast
primaryAbilities.description: Kayle conjures a portal, summoning a celestial sword that pierces through enemies, slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Kayle fires a celestial sword that stops on the first enemy hit, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>, <status>Slowing</status> by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds, and removing <scaleArmor>{{ shredpercent }}% Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> for {{ shredduration }} seconds from the target and enemies behind them.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Celestial Blessing
primaryAbilities.description: Blessed by the divine, Kayle heals and grants Move Speed to herself and the nearest ally.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Kayle infuses herself and an allied champion with light, restoring <healing>{{ totalheal }} Health</healing> and granting <speed>{{ totalhaste }} Move Speed</speed> for {{ hasteduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Starfire Spellblade
primaryAbilities.description:
Passive: Kayle's celestial sword, Virtue, deals bonus magic damage to enemies she attacks.

Active: Kayle's next attack smites her target with celestial fire, dealing bonus damage proportionate to their missing health.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Passive: Attacks deal an additional {{ epassivetotaldamage }} magic damage.

Active: Kayle's next attack becomes ranged and deals an additional {{ activetotalexecutedamage }} missing Health magic damage. This attack upgrades when Kayle reaches Level {{ spell.kaylepassive:levelforpassiverank2 }}, causing it to explode when it hits the target, dealing damage to nearby enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Divine Judgment
primaryAbilities.description: Kayle makes an ally invulnerable and calls upon former Aspects of Justice to purify the area around her target with a holy rain of swords.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Kayle makes an allied champion Invulnerable for {{ invulnduration }} seconds and then purifies the area around them, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
